<h2>Build an sjSDM Artifact Envelope</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Builds and validates one native cross-validation v2 artifact.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>build_sjsdm_artifact_envelope(
  artifact_type = NULL,
  payload = NULL,
  provenance = NULL
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="artifact_type">artifact_type</code></td>
<td>
<p>Registered non-empty character scalar artifact type.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="payload">payload</code></td>
<td>
<p>Named list with the exact payload names registered for the artifact type.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="provenance">provenance</code></td>
<td>
<p>One-row data frame with common and artifact-specific provenance.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Validated named v2 artifact list with deterministic content hash.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>build_sjsdm_artifact_envelope(
  artifact_type = "sjsdm_cv_predictions",
  payload = list(
    data_predictions = tibble::tibble(),
    data_fold_diagnostics = tibble::tibble()
  ),
  provenance = tibble::tibble(
    created_at = as.POSIXct("2026-08-11", tz = "UTC"),
    pipeline_id = "pipeline_paleo_core",
    configuration_profile = "project_cz_paleo",
    source_schema_version = "2.0.0",
    migration_applied = FALSE,
    migration_function = NA_character_
  )
)
</code></pre>
